description: Web interface for MariaDB, served locally by OpenMind's portable PHP.

features.label: Web interface
features.missingNote: index.php isn't in this install. Use Repair to reinstall it.

notes: Official phpMyAdmin all-languages ZIP from files.phpmyadmin.net (SHA256 from its .sha256 file). OpenMind Studio writes its config.inc.php when you start it (host 127.0.0.1, your MariaDB port, cookie login) and serves it with `php -S` on 127.0.0.1 only.
